name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Tag to backfill (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Determine TAG from release
        if: github.event_name == 'release'
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          echo "TAG=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Determine TAG from dispatch
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          TAG_INPUT: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: |
          echo "TAG=$TAG_INPUT" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Parse tag
        run: |
          TAG=${TAG#v}
          MAJOR=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d. -f1)
          MINOR=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d. -f2)
          PATCH=$(echo "$TAG" | cut -d. -f3)
          echo "MAJOR=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MINOR=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PATCH=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set release name
        if: github.event_name == 'release'
        env:
          RELEASE_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.name }}
        run: echo "RELEASE_NAME=$RELEASE_NAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Checkout tag
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ env.TAG }}

      - name: Create docs branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b docs/v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}
          git push --force origin docs/v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}

      - name: Create Gitbook variant
        if: env.PATCH == '0'
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(printf '{"name":"V%s.%s - %s","branch":"docs/v%s.%s"}' "$MAJOR" "$MINOR" "$RELEASE_NAME" "$MAJOR" "$MINOR")"
